name: localix-grammar
description: Precise AI grammar, spelling, punctuation, and style checks in supported web editors.

scripts.format: prettier --write src/ tests/ scripts/ docs/ .github/ AGENTS.md CLAUDE.md README.md PRIVACY_POLICY.md CONTRIBUTING.md CHANGELOG.md SECURITY.md THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md manifest.json package.json tsconfig.json vite.config.ts vitest.config.ts playwright.config.ts
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src/ tests/ scripts/ docs/ .github/ AGENTS.md CLAUDE.md README.md PRIVACY_POLICY.md CONTRIBUTING.md CHANGELOG.md SECURITY.md THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md manifest.json package.json tsconfig.json vite.config.ts vitest.config.ts playwright.config.ts
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build && npm run validate:dist
scripts.verify: npm run check && npm run test:coverage && npm run test:e2e && npm audit --audit-level=high
scripts.zip: npm run check && mkdir -p dist-zip && rm -f dist-zip/localix-grammar.zip dist-zip/localix-grammar.zip.sha256 && cd dist && zip -Xqr ../dist-zip/localix-grammar.zip . && cd .. && unzip -tq dist-zip/localix-grammar.zip && shasum -a 256 dist-zip/localix-grammar.zip > dist-zip/localix-grammar.zip.sha256

author: Localix <hello@localix.ai> (https://localix.ai)
